entries.title: AEQ Specification
entries.changed: First change to a validated section since v1.0. Section 4 previously said the three efficiency layers are independently addressable and that fixing one does not require touching the others. It now states that addressable independently does not mean measurable independently, because an intervention on one layer moves the measured value of another, observed running in both directions. Layer 3 gains an applicability note: its definition assumes completion tokens are the visible response, which fails on reasoning-tier models. A returning reader who knows the three-layer model will notice that AEQ is now explicitly defined on total tokens with the layers as attribution rather than addends.
